summary: Show photos from your computer as a slideshow, with the screen on or waking on a schedule. Needs your computer.
page_description: Turn a Kobo into a low-power black-and-white photo frame. Send albums from your computer, then choose a slideshow that keeps the screen on or wakes the reader every few hours.
release_notes: Frame opens to the photograph on the whole panel inside a narrow white mat. Tap the sides for the next or previous one, the middle for what it is, and the top for the bar with Settings.

steps.text: Set up the reader once over USB, if you have not already.
Send a photo or a folder of photos. Each push adds to the frame, and Frame shows new photos the next time it changes photo or you come back to it.
